item.title: Framework & Architecture Interview Questions
item.description:
Beginner (Basics & Definitions)

  1. What is an automation framework and why is it needed?
  2. Explain your project framework in detail?
  3. What is POM (Page Object Model) and its advantages?
  4. Explain the differences and similarities between POM and Page Factory?
  5. What are dependencies in a framework and how are they managed?
  6. Explain the role of pom.xml in your framework?
  7. What are the different types of frameworks (Data-driven, Keyword-driven, Hybrid)?

Questions with Answers

Beginner (Basics & Definitions)

What is an automation framework and why is it needed?

Answer: An automation framework is a set of guidelines, protocols, and tools used to structure automation code. It is needed to improve code reusability, maintainability, and to reduce the effort needed to create and run tests.
